methodology: The original research topic and the generated technical specification were decomposed into atomic information units based on individual requirements, features, behaviors, constraints, and input/output specifications. Each atomic unit is designed to be independent, self-contained, technically specific, unambiguous, and implementable as a single requirement. Overlapping information was avoided. The decomposition focused on extracting the core functionalities and constraints described in both documents.
mindtraced_atomic_units: Lemmings are modeled using a finite state machine.
Lemmings can be in walk_left state (walk_left = 1).
Lemmings can be in walk_right state (walk_right = 1).
Lemmings switch direction if bumped on the left (bump_left = 1).
Lemmings switch direction if bumped on the right (bump_right = 1).
Lemmings switch direction if bumped on both sides (bump_left = 1 and bump_right = 1).
When ground = 0, Lemming falls and 'aaah' output is 1.
When ground = 1 after falling, Lemming resumes walking in the same direction.
Bump inputs are ignored while falling.
Bump inputs are ignored in the same cycle as ground disappears.
Bump inputs are ignored when the ground reappears while still falling.
Lemming can dig if ground = 1 and not falling and dig = 1.
Lemming continues digging until ground = 0.
When ground = 0 after digging, Lemming falls and 'aaah' output is 1.
Bump inputs are ignored while digging.
Dig input is ignored when falling or when there is no ground.
Fall has higher precedence than dig, which has higher precedence than switching directions.
If Lemming falls for more than 20 clock cycles and then hits the ground, it will splatter.
When Lemming splatters, walk_left, walk_right, aaah, and digging outputs become 0.
Splattering occurs only when hitting the ground after falling for too long.
areset asynchronously resets the Lemming to walk left state.
clk is the clock input.
areset is the asynchronous reset input.
bump_left is the left bump input.
bump_right is the right bump input.
ground is the ground detection input.
dig is the dig initiation input.
walk_left is the output indicating walking left.
walk_right is the output indicating walking right.
aaah is the output indicating falling.
digging is the output indicating digging.
spec_atomic_units: Combinational logic determines outputs based on inputs and current state.
Precedence of actions is fall > dig > direction change.
aaah output is asserted when ground = 0.
digging output is asserted when dig = 1 and ground = 1.
walk_left and walk_right indicate walking direction, changing based on bump_left and bump_right.
areset resets the Lemming to the walking left state.
Combinational logic accounts for the splatter condition.
splatter condition overrides all other outputs.
If bump_left is asserted, Lemming changes direction to walk right.
If bump_right is asserted, Lemming changes direction to walk left.
If both bump_left and bump_right are asserted, Lemming changes direction.
Current walking direction is stored in the state.
walk_left and walk_right are mutually exclusive.
Falling condition has the highest precedence.
Digging condition has lower precedence than falling.
If Lemming is falling, aaah output is asserted regardless of dig and bump inputs.
If Lemming is not falling but dig is asserted and ground is asserted, digging output is asserted regardless of bump inputs.
If Lemming is neither falling nor digging, bump inputs determine walking direction.
splattered output is asserted when Lemming has fallen for more than 20 clock cycles and then hits the ground.
When splattered is asserted, all other outputs are deasserted.
areset asynchronously resets the state machine to the walking left state.
clk clocks all state transitions.
bump_left, bump_right, ground, and dig inputs affect state transitions on the rising edge of clk.
walk_left, walk_right, aaah, and digging are synchronous with clk.
Falling duration is tracked using a counter.
If ground is 0 for more than 20 clock cycles, and then ground becomes 1, the Lemming splatters.
Falling duration counter is incremented when ground is 0 and reset when ground is 1 or when areset is asserted.
Outputs are assigned based on the current state variables.
